summary: Maase Inc., a Cayman-incorporated China-based issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 23, 2026 securities purchase agreement for a $50 million private placement (PIPE) of 3,878,856 Class A ordinary shares at $12.89 per share to a single purchaser under Regulation D/Section 4(a)(2). The shares carry a 36-month lock-up, with closing expected in October 2026. Proceeds fund the Star Distributed Intelligent Computing Centers project and Lingyanmiaoyu mixture-of-experts LLM commercialization, plus working capital. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock disclosed. Watch dilution, purchaser identity, and closing-condition risk.
